## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

Fixes #

## User interface

For a user-interface change, include screenshots or a short recording at both
desktop and phone widths. Remove this section when it does not apply.

## Validation

- [ ] Ruff, repository hygiene, and TypeScript checks pass.
- [ ] `python3 -m pytest -q` passes.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] Browser acceptance passes for frontend changes.
- [ ] I tested affected UI behavior in Home Assistant.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] I updated the changelog for user-visible changes.
- [ ] I understand the submitted code and can explain how it works.
- [ ] This change contains no credentials, device addresses, captured household commands, or other private data.
